basics.name: Pavel Savinov
basics.label: Senior Backend Engineer (Go)
basics.summary: I build production Go services: search-results APIs, asynchronous logistics workflows and promotion systems. My work at Aviasales, Uzum and Avito spans performance profiling, PostgreSQL data modelling, Kafka, transactional outbox, SLOs and incident response.

work.name: Uzum Market (Uzum Technologies)
work.summary: Backend for the marketplace's parcel-sorting warehouses. Go, PostgreSQL and asynchronous workflows over Kafka.
highlights: Took phase 2 of the sorting-center program from PRD to production in 4 months: domain and PostgreSQL data model, Kafka integration via transactional outbox, and most of the service implementation. Live at the first sorting center; rollout to approximately 10 centers was planned.
Designed per-item routing over a graph of sorting walls and cells, with topology checks and load balancing across duplicate walls.
Encoded sorting rules as domain invariants in a dedicated stage-transition module and defined SLOs for core operations.

work.name: Aviasales
work.summary: Search-results API for a flight-search platform.
highlights: Improved search-results API latency through pprof-driven profiling, caching and request shaping.
Freed approximately 1 GB of RAM per instance (approximately 30%) across hundreds of instances by fixing memory leaks and retuning caches.

Designed and shipped config-driven badges with the expr expression language. Moved badge logic from iOS, Android and web clients to the backend; rollout went from a sprint plus mobile releases to a 30-minute config change.
Wrote a search-results storage design from access-pattern analysis and load projections across three data centers. It started the redesign; the Search team implemented its own version.

work.name: Avito
work.summary: Paid promotions and Billing integration. Go and PHP.
highlights: Owned SLOs, alerting, tail-latency and timeout fixes across 20+ promotion microservices, keeping 99.9%+ availability at approximately 3.5k RPS.
Migrated a Redis cache serving approximately 3.5k RPS from a single instance to a sharded cluster with a phased rollout.
Designed a feature-flagged cutover from legacy promotions to a new architecture, with fail-safes and rollback; delivered Billing integration for a new paid feature.

work.name: Far Eastern Federal University
work.summary: Taught Databases (PostgreSQL) and Web Programming to 50+ students.

projects.name: pr-review
projects.description: An agent skill that reviews a pull request by running it: three builds, one subtraction, then probes for behavior that tests do not cover.

projects.name: ProtonDB compatibility prediction
projects.description: A two-stage LightGBM classifier predicting Linux game compatibility from 350K+ community reports. Built with Claude Code as a research partner; per-game F1 of 0.871.

projects.name: Graph LLM Chat
projects.description: A local-first branching chat UI with streaming, token accounting, summarization at context limits and multi-server MCP integration.
